capabilities.description: Work Saban is an Evercraft product inviting private pilot interest for a simple monthly sales CSV reporting task: describe the task, review the proposed specialist team, and evaluate an independently checked local sample report. The current workers are local deterministic stages only, not a hosted multi-tenant AI service or general-purpose autonomous employees. No public file uploads, commercial checkout or paid work.
